about: LAYER INTAKE QUEUE (Oct 28 2026, HQ item B). Every map-layer lead anyone finds goes here as one row; kpc_intake_bot.py probes each unprobed row politely and writes its verdict to ready.json + review.md. Row shape: see README.md. 'expect' = the known answer for a test row (chat 9's last probe list; the bot prints ok / MISS and GATE=PASS when all agree).
